Osmanthus Jelly With Wolfberries
By: Blackswan
Published: Sunday, March 17, 2013 - 8:31pm

Ingredients




1 pkt of Konyaku jelly powder
600ml Water
1 tsp Dried Osmanthus
1 tsp Wolfberries

Preparation

1 Soak Wolfberries till soft. Drain & set aside. 2 Heat water & mix #Konyaku according to instructions on the box. Adjust water according to sweetness & texture preference; I used 600ml. 3 Make sure Konyaku is well dissolved before you stir in herbs. Let it simmer for about 2 mins while stirring it continuously. 4 Fill the jelly moulds with mixture & let it cool before refrigerating. 5 Serve your scented Osmanthus Jelly With Wolfberries chilled!

About

The combination of the two wonder herbs makes this Osmanthus Jelly With Wolfberries a delightful dessert, ending my dinner on a sweet note.
